Name: Animated Seed Makers
Author: sproggen
Description:
This mod gives you three new seed makers that are all continuously animated. You get a sleepy cat, a decorative rockpile, and a mysterious seed merchant.

*This mod requires the "Alternative Textures" mod to work.*
 
 To install: unzip and drag the unzipped folder into your mods folder.
 
 Use the paintbucket tool from the "Alternative Textures" mod in game to retexture seed makers individually.
 
 Enjoy!
